## What this adds

- **Name**:
- **URL** (repository, or the skill's folder inside one):
- **Category** (a skill category, or Collections / Official / Tools / Tutorials & Articles / Community):
- **Works with** (Claude Code / Codex / Cursor / Gemini CLI / Copilot, or Any on its own):

## Affiliation

Are you the author, maintainer, employer, or otherwise connected to this project?

- [ ] Yes -- I am connected to this project
- [ ] No -- I am not connected to this project

Submitting your own work is welcome. Hiding that you did is not: undisclosed self-promotion gets the entry removed.

## Quality standards

Confirming these against [CONTRIBUTING.md](../CONTRIBUTING.md#quality-standards):

- [ ] The repository or folder holds a `SKILL.md` whose YAML frontmatter has a `name` and a `description`
- [ ] It states an open-source licence: a `LICENSE` file, a package manifest field, or the `license` field of its `SKILL.md`
- [ ] Its README says how to install or use the skill
- [ ] It was pushed within the last 180 days and is not archived
- [ ] It is not already listed, and not a second copy of a skill already covered
- [ ] It is not a fork of another project
- [ ] I read its `SKILL.md` and scripts, and nothing in them hides what it does

## Format

- [ ] Description is 80 characters or fewer, starts with a capital, has no trailing period, and uses `--` rather than an em-dash
- [ ] Description states what it does rather than selling it
- [ ] Works with names only agents its README supports, or `Any` on its own for a skill with no agent-specific parts
- [ ] Added in alphabetical order within its table (preferred, but it will not fail any check)
- [ ] `python scripts/validate.py` passes locally
- [ ] I have starred the repository (required before a pull request merges itself)
- [ ] I have not changed any unrelated entry
